system.description:
Choose one Exotic Weapon or one of the following weapon groups: Advanced Melee, Heavy Weapons, Pistols, Rifles, or Simple Weapons. You gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls with the chosen Exotic Weapon or a weapon from the chosen group. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by the Weapon Specialization Talent.

You may select this Talent multiple times. Each time you select this Talent, it applies to a different Exotic Weapon or weapon group.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook
